_meta.description: Calibration parameters for the synthetic Vietnamese e-commerce dataset. Each parameter has an STT matching Bang_tong_hop_input_Buoc3.md.

simulation.source: Step 2 (Quy_tac_tinh_toan_RFM-D.md): ANALYSIS_DATE = last day of the last complete month in the data

Hồ Chí Minh.source: Metric Q1/2024, 5 platforms: HCMC > 14,000 bn VND out of 71,200 bn VND (rounded)

Hà Nội.source: Metric Q1/2024, 5 platforms: Hanoi > 20,000 bn VND out of 71,200 bn VND (rounded)

province_base_weights_rest._note: Relative weights for the 13 remaining provinces and 'Other'. Normalised so the total equals 1 - (HCMC + Hanoi). Assumption (STT 38).

Shopee.source: VnExpress 2024 (GMV share of the 4 platforms, 13.8 bn USD)

TikTok Shop.source: VnExpress 2024 (GMV share of the 4 platforms, 13.8 bn USD)

Lazada.source: Remainder 0.064 split by an assumed ratio of 6:1

Tiki.source: Remainder 0.064 split by an assumed ratio of 6:1

Electronics & Home Appliances.source: YouNet ECI Q4/2024: 'Điện gia dụng & công nghệ' (home appliances & technology) grouped as one category

Other.source: Remainder: 1 minus the total of the four categories above

Electronics & Home Appliances.note: Weighted average of Home Appliances (950,000) and Electronics (1,800,000) using the previous shares

payment_share_by_count._note: Share by transaction count, rounded. The total is 1.01 due to rounding; it is normalised in code.

Cash on Delivery (COD).source: PCMI E-commerce Data Library (updated 11/2024); secondary confirmation from Kinh tế & Tài chính journal (COD ~67%)

urban_payment_tilt.note: Qualitative direction only; the magnitude is a simulation parameter

tet.note: Tết dates are verified. The 2.5x and 3.0x multipliers are assumptions. Metric pre-Tết 2025 data shows +9% revenue and +5% volume, which does not match 2.5x

geo_score_tier.note: 3/2/1 scale from the theoretical framework (Large Urban / Medium Urban / Rural). No official urban classification by province exists yet, so this is an assumption

validation_tolerance.note: Thresholds for flagging a check as 'LỆCH' in calibration_log.json

purchase_frequency.note: Assumed distribution of purchases per year. No Vietnam-specific source; chosen by hand, not calibrated
